---
title: "TAMU Gardens in Focus"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [cosmo, styles.scss]
    embed-resources: true
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("R/utils.R")

usgs_site   <- "USGS-08108700"  # Brazos Rv at SH 21 nr Bryan, TX -- see R/utils.R for why not 08109500
nws_station <- "KCLL"

white_creek <- load_white_creek_temp("data/garden") |> flag_air_exposure()
river       <- fetch_usgs_gage_height(usgs_site, start = Sys.Date() - 30, end = Sys.Date())
weather_now <- fetch_nws_latest(nws_station)
weather_hx  <- fetch_nws_observations(nws_station, n = 168)
```

# White Creek Temperature

## Row {height=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Latest reading"
#| class: compact-value
latest_temp <- white_creek |> slice_max(datetime, n = 1)
list(
  icon = "thermometer-half",
  color = "light",
  value = if (nrow(latest_temp) == 0) "no data yet" else paste0(round(latest_temp$temp_f, 1), " °F")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "As of"
#| class: compact-value
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = "light",
  value = if (nrow(latest_temp) == 0) "--" else format(latest_temp$datetime, "%b %d, %Y %I:%M %p")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Records logged"
#| class: compact-value
list(
  icon = "database",
  color = "light",
  value = format(nrow(white_creek), big.mark = ",")
)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Water temperature over time"
if (nrow(white_creek) == 0) {
  plotly::plot_ly() |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = "No HOBO data synced yet -- run scripts/sync_garden_data.py",
      xaxis = list(visible = FALSE), yaxis = list(visible = FALSE)
    )
} else {
  p <- white_creek |>
    ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = temp_f)) +
    geom_line(color = "#2b6cb0", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Temperature (°F)") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
  plotly::ggplotly(p) |> plotly::layout(dragmode = "zoom")
}
```

## Row {height=8%}

```{r}
#| output: asis
n_excl <- attr(white_creek, "n_excluded")
if (!is.null(n_excl) && n_excl > 0) {
  cat(paste0(
    "*", n_excl, " reading", if (n_excl != 1) "s" else "",
    " excluded from this chart as likely sensor air exposure ",
    "(outside 32-100°F -- logger exposed above waterline, not real water temp).*"
  ))
}
```

# Brazos River

## Row {height=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Latest gage height"
latest_gage <- river |> slice_max(datetime, n = 1)
list(
  icon = "water",
  color = "light",
  value = if (nrow(latest_gage) == 0) "unavailable" else paste0(round(latest_gage$gage_height_ft, 2), " ft")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "As of"
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = "light",
  value = if (nrow(latest_gage) == 0) "--" else format(latest_gage$datetime, "%b %d, %Y %I:%M %p")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Station"
list(icon = "geo-alt", color = "light", value = usgs_site)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Gage height, last 30 days"
if (nrow(river) == 0) {
  plotly::plot_ly() |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = "USGS OGC API returned no data for this window",
      xaxis = list(visible = FALSE), yaxis = list(visible = FALSE)
    )
} else {
  p <- river |>
    ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = gage_height_ft)) +
    geom_line(color = "#2c7a5b", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Gage height (ft)") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
  plotly::ggplotly(p) |> plotly::layout(dragmode = "zoom")
}
```

# Weather

## Row {height=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Current temperature"
list(
  icon = "sun",
  color = "light",
  value = if (is.na(weather_now$temp_c[1])) "unavailable" else paste0(round(weather_now$temp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1), " °F")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Conditions"
list(
  icon = "cloud",
  color = "light",
  value = if (is.na(weather_now$description[1])) "unavailable" else weather_now$description
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Precip, last hour"
# NA here means "not reported by the station," not "no rain" -- do not
# display as 0. This is the second bug fixed in the prior HTML version;
# same trap applies to this data source in R.
list(
  icon = "cloud-rain",
  color = "light",
  value = if (is.na(weather_now$precip_mm[1])) "not reported" else paste0(round(weather_now$precip_mm, 1), " mm")
)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Temperature, last 7 days (KCLL / Easterwood Field)"
if (nrow(weather_hx) == 0) {
  plotly::plot_ly() |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = "NWS API returned no data",
      xaxis = list(visible = FALSE), yaxis = list(visible = FALSE)
    )
} else {
  p <- weather_hx |>
    mutate(temp_f = temp_c * 9/5 + 32) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = temp_f)) +
    geom_line(color = "#b7791f", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Temperature (°F)") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
  plotly::ggplotly(p) |> plotly::layout(dragmode = "zoom")
}
```
